Initial release – Book real-world local services via Lokuli MCP.
- Supports 75+ service types, including auto, beauty, home, health, events, and more.
- Tools for searching providers, checking availability, fetching details, listing service categories, and getting pricing estimates.
- End-to-end workflow: find providers, show options and pricing, check time slots, confirm, and generate Stripe payment links.
- Includes validation for serviceable ZIP codes and alternative AP2 cart creation.
- Requires explicit user confirmation and essential contact details before booking.
